title: JTS-MM: An open-source multimodal jaw tracking measurement system
description: Hardware, firmware, recording software, and analysis code of JTS-MM, a low-cost system that records six-degree-of-freedom jaw kinematics, surface electromyography of the masticatory muscles, and inertial signals on one hardware clock. The repository also holds, for each study, the analysis plan as frozen, a change log of every later change, the declarations of all figures, tables, and numbers of the papers, and the supplementary results with the data behind them.
notes: Licences by part: MIT (software, firmware, scripts, tests, configuration), CERN-OHL-P-2.0 (hardware design files), CC-BY-4.0 (documentation, figures, result tables). The included first-generation jaw-tracking package keeps CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Every file states its licence in an SPDX header or in REUSE.toml.
